`solve_model` still obtains callback snapshots from the current `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` only flattens a supplied MultiIndex; it does not recover the model’s stored representation. For example, after building a flat multi-period model, changing the network snapshots to a DatetimeIndex causes `solve_model` to pass that DatetimeIndex unchanged, rather than the flat tuple index used to build the model.
